summary: Tested the preview URL on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844), the 10 guides, the Amazon Associate statement in the footer and on the disclosure page, and admin Sources (Test all, refresh, add and delete). New pytest file: 22/22 passed. Browser: home loads fully with 0 console errors and 0px horizontal overflow on desktop and mobile. Home numbers the guides 01..10. /guides lists 10 guides and a guide page opens with content. Footer text matches exactly on every page. Admin login with the password works. Sources tab lists the 4 user sources. In Test all, nitter RSS (21 posts) and @wealthydimes (18 posts) are Readable. @hotdealsbywd and @tapworthy show 'owner has turned off Telegram's public web preview'. A TEST_ source's refresh showed an import error and its delete worked. The 4 user sources were kept. No deals were created.

issues: Only guide 01 has an image. Cards 02 and 03 in the first row leave a large empty gap under them. Add images to all guides or remove the image from the first card.
The nitter RSS source shows as 'nitter.mie.foundation'. A name like '@Starcommander10 (X via nitter)' would be clearer.

action_items: Optional: turn off or replace @hotdealsbywd and @tapworthy. They are enabled, so every scheduled Import drafts run will log the same 'public web preview' error.
Optional: give the nitter source a clear name. The public nitter instance may go down at any time, so keep a backup source.
Optional: make the /guides card layout even (all with images or none).
